blogs.title: Small Models, Big Math: How DeepSeekMath Beats Giants Without the Bloat
blogs.description: Discover how a modest 7-billion parameter model, DeepSeekMath, is outperforming massive closed-source rivals like GPT-4 on complex math benchmarks. This post breaks down the surprising finding that high-quality data curation from the open web can beat sheer model size, and explains why starting with a coding-focused model gives math reasoning a significant boost.

blogs.title: The Secret Sauce of Math AI: Why Scraping the Web Works Better Than Reading ArXiv
blogs.description: Contrary to popular belief in the AI research community, training on academic papers (ArXiv) didn't yield the best results for mathematical reasoning. Learn about DeepSeek's innovative data pipeline that mines 120 billion tokens from Common Crawl using an iterative filtering process, and why this 'messy' web data turned out to be far more valuable than curated scientific literature for teaching LLMs to solve equations.

blogs.title: GRPO Explained: The New Reinforcement Learning Trick That Saves Memory and Boosts Smarts
blogs.description: Reinforcement learning is powerful but often computationally expensive due to the need for a separate 'critic' model. This post introduces Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), a clever new algorithm from DeepSeek that eliminates the critic by comparing groups of answers directly. We explain how this simplification reduces memory usage while pushing math accuracy over 50% on competition-level problems.

blogs.title: Beyond Right Answers: How RL Teaches AI to Be Consistently Good at Math
blogs.description: Why does Reinforcement Learning (RL) make such a huge difference for math models? This article dives into the 'Unified Paradigm' proposed by DeepSeek researchers, revealing that RL doesn't necessarily teach a model *new* math facts, but rather aligns its probability distribution to consistently pick the correct solution from its existing knowledge. We explore concepts like 'outcome vs. process supervision' and why this matters for future AI reliability.
